# Goleu AI

> Goleu AI is a free tool for AI builders: describe the AI app you want to build in one line and get an LLM, framework, vector database and hosting stack with an estimated monthly cost.

Goleu AI requires no sign-up. You write one sentence, choose monthly active users (100 to 100,000) and a priority (lowest cost, balanced, best quality), and get a stack recommendation in about 10 seconds. Monthly costs are calculated from official pricing pages; each result shows the assumptions (requests per user, tokens per request) and the date prices were checked. Some links may be affiliate links; rankings do not depend on them.

## Main pages

- [Home](%SITE_URL%/): What Goleu AI does, how it works, and FAQ
- [AI stack recommender](%SITE_URL%/build): One-line description to stack and monthly cost
- [LLM API cost calculator](%SITE_URL%/llm-cost): Monthly cost of major LLM APIs from daily requests and tokens, with prompt-caching estimates for RAG and agent workloads; open-weight models (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) shown both via the official API and a US host
- [Privacy Policy](%SITE_URL%/privacy): What data is collected and how long it is kept (Korean)
- [Terms of Service](%SITE_URL%/terms): Terms of use (Korean)
